scope: Propuesta visual de parrilla de carbón: directo e indirecto. No es un arte editorial publicado ni un plano de montaje.
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Create a polished high-resolution landscape 3:2 technical illustration asset for the Lumbre fire planner. The provided image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: reproduce its detailed black ink engraved cross-hatching and precise culinary equipment illustration language, not its layout, text, branding, nutritional or temperature claims.
Deliver a single comparison plate with TWO equally large beautiful technical cutaway charcoal kettle grills, left direct heat, right indirect heat. Pure warm-white nearly white background, black ink and small restrained dark brick-red #7b251b highlights. No aged paper, no grime, no photorealistic rendering, no simplistic vector icon geometry. Rich accurate physical form, elegant etched metal texture, hand-drawn technical editorial craft.
Composition: each kettle is a CLOSED LID round charcoal grill shown with a clearly intentional front quarter cutaway, so the visible dome remains in its operating position. Three-quarter perspective. Matching scale. Grills fill almost all the canvas with generous clean margins and a narrow gutter between panels. Both have one upper cooking grate, a clearly separate lower fuel grate, deep curved bowl and sturdy legs. No flames touching food. No fake gauges with numbers. No printed words, labels, logos, numbers, title or border; typography will be composed outside the asset.
LEFT: a modest bed of charcoal on the lower grate centered directly UNDER a single steak on the cooking grate. Small red ember edges. Two thin brick-red upward arrows show heat rising from charcoal toward steak. Keep the physical separation between food grate and fuel grate obvious.
RIGHT: two small charcoal baskets on the lower grate, one on each SIDE of an EMPTY CENTER. A small roast rests on the upper cooking grate exactly above the empty center and a drip pan on the lower level. Absolutely NO charcoal directly below the roast or center drip pan. Thin brick-red arrows rise from the two side baskets, curve up beneath the closed dome and toward the center, illustrating indirect heat circulation. No arrows inside meat. No fire in the drip pan.
Prioritize mechanically coherent construction, charcoal placement, unmistakable comparison and detailed engaging illustration over decoration. This is a conceptual educational cutaway, not an assembly instruction. Crisp at mobile width.
review: Se observan brasas bajo el alimento en directo; dos canastas laterales y bandeja central sin brasas en indirecto. Estilo grabado detallado. Pendiente aprobación visual del usuario e integración por escenario.
